description: This Java class defines a 'Transaction' entity used in an Android-based server context. It encapsulates details of a purchase transaction including item ID, user ID, and a nonce for replay attack prevention. The class provides methods for serialization into byte arrays, equality checks, and hash code generation.

classes.name: Transaction
classes.description: Represents a purchase transaction with item ID, user ID, and client nonce. Supports serialization to byte array, equality, and hash code methods.

methods.name: Transaction
methods.description: Constructor initializing transaction with user ID, item ID, and client nonce.

methods.name: getUserId
methods.description: Returns the user ID associated with the transaction.

methods.name: toByteArray
methods.description: Serializes the transaction data into a byte array for transmission or storage.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Overrides Object.equals to compare transactions based on item ID, user ID, and nonce.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Overrides Object.hashCode to generate hash based on transaction fields.
